reason: The README describes an enterprise companion centered on multi-step task orchestration, scheduling, retries, queues, and resumable execution, with substantial supporting collaboration, knowledge, security, search, export, and cost-management features.

summaries.zh: 面向企业开发团队的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供多步任务编排、自动化执行、团队协作、知识管理、安全审计和对话检索导出功能。
summaries.en: An enterprise DeepSeek Harness plugin for multi-step task orchestration, automated execution, team collaboration, knowledge management, security auditing, and conversation search and export.

capabilities: Defines and runs multi-step pipelines with branching, dependencies, retries, scheduling, queues, and resumable execution
Audits operations and detects sensitive data such as API keys, phone numbers, email addresses, and passwords using configurable rules
Stores and manages named keys with scopes, rotation reminders, and exposure detection
Supports team configuration, knowledge snapshots, experience notes, reviews, and shared decision records
Compares multiple models and analyzes execution traces, token usage, latency, and anomalies
Exports conversations to Markdown, PDF, JSON, and ZIP and provides handoff summaries and full-text search
Accesses DeepSeek APIs and official pricing pages for model use and dynamic cost reporting
